content: qemu vmnet netdevs (vmnet-host/vmnet-shared/vmnet-bridged) merged in qemu 7.1 (2022), require macOS 11+, and REQUIRE root OR the restricted com.apple.vm.networking entitlement (Apple docs: sandboxed process must hold entitlement; qemu-devel patch series confirms unprivileged use fails with 'general failure'). nix-built qemu is unsigned/unentitled so builtin vmnet = sudo qemu. Unprivileged path: lima-vm/socket_vmnet v1.2.2 (Apache-2.0) — root daemon (launchd/brew services, one-time privileged setup) serves vmnet over /var/run/socket_vmnet; unmodified qemu connects unprivileged via socket_vmnet_client SOCK -netdev socket,id=net0,fd=3 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0; guest gets macOS bootpd DHCP and is reachable from the host (verified in socket_vmnet README). socket_vmnet is packaged in nixpkgs as socket-vmnet (pkgs/by-name/so/socket-vmnet) and homebrew (keg-only).
